air_conditioner.lore.rare: Breathes frost on anyone who says 'it's a bit warm in here', and they walk out with icicles on their eyebrows.
air_conditioner.lore.epic: Blew so hard in a heatwave that it pushed the whole house a metre into the shade. The postman now knocks on the wrong door.
air_conditioner.lore.legendary: Blew a cold snap out of the window so big that it snowed on one street in August, and the children built a snowman in swimming shorts.

x_bath_bomb.lore.rare: Fizzes in any water it touches, so the dog's bowl, the fish tank and the kettle all smell of lavender.
x_bath_bomb.lore.legendary: Fizzed so hard that it launched the bath through the roof like a rocket. The bather landed in next door's paddling pool, still holding the soap.

bathtub.lore.common: Takes forty minutes to fill and four seconds to go cold the moment anyone gets in.
bathtub.lore.rare: Gurgles rude noises down the plughole whenever a guest is in the bath, and everyone downstairs pretends not to hear.
bathtub.lore.epic: Overflowed for so long that the kitchen below got a ceiling waterfall, and Dad stood under it with the shampoo.
bathtub.lore.legendary: Sailed down the high street on bath night with its bather still in it, and stopped politely at every red light.

blender.lore.uncommon: Walks across the counter on its own while it blends, always heading for the edge.
blender.lore.rare: Sucks in anything left beside it, so the shopping list, a tea towel and Grandad's glasses came out as one green smoothie.
blender.lore.legendary: Blended a thunderstorm on picnic day. Everyone got sunshine, plus a fizzy drink that rumbled.

x_fountain_pen_ink.lore.common: Turns every pen it fills into a slightly leaky pen, always in a white shirt pocket.
x_fountain_pen_ink.lore.rare: Refuses to be crossed out: every line struck through it turns into a neat underline instead.
x_fountain_pen_ink.lore.epic: Tipped over on the exam papers, and the whole class's answers ran together into one giant blue essay that got a B.
x_fountain_pen_ink.lore.legendary: Wrote a whole novel by itself overnight. The hero is a fountain pen, and it wins in the end.

x_birdbath.lore.common: Gets used by one bird at a time, and that bird is always the biggest, grumpiest pigeon.
x_birdbath.lore.rare: Gives any bird that bathes in it a voice it can't control, so the crows now sing opera at five in the morning.
x_birdbath.lore.epic: Froze solid one winter, and the ducks used it as an ice rink. A robin now gives skating lessons.
x_birdbath.lore.legendary: Was so popular that a whole migrating flock changed its route south to stop by. They now spend the winter in the back garden.

bucket.lore.rare: Is never fully empty: there is always one more splash left in it, aimed at the last dry sock.
bucket.lore.legendary: Scooped up the whole sea in one go at the beach, and only put it back when the lifeguard blew his whistle.

x_well.lore.rare: Answers any question shouted down it, but always with another question.
x_well.lore.epic: Hiccuped up every coin ever thrown into it, and the village fete was showered with pennies for an hour.
x_well.lore.legendary: Granted a boy's wish for 'a bucket of ice cream' exactly. The bucket is the size of a lake and is still on its way up.

x_rain_barrel_tank.lore.rare: Sends a little rain cloud after anyone who forgets to water the plants, so they get the watering instead.
x_rain_barrel_tank.lore.epic: Overflowed so far in a storm that the garden gnome sailed past the kitchen window on a lettuce leaf.
x_rain_barrel_tank.lore.legendary: Collected one raindrop from every cloud in the sky, and now the weather has to ask its permission before it rains.

x_soup_can.lore.common: Gets opened by a tin opener that always stops just before the last little bit.
x_soup_can.lore.rare: Heats itself the moment anyone nearby says 'I'm cold', so the supermarket soup aisle is always steaming.
x_soup_can.lore.epic: Rolled out of a shopping bag at the top of a hill, and the whole bus queue chased it to the bottom.
x_soup_can.lore.legendary: Was opened on the Moon by an astronaut, and the soup floated out in one perfect red ball. He drank it with a straw.

x_water_tank.lore.rare: Pushes water up instead of down, so the shower sometimes rains from the floor.
x_water_tank.lore.epic: Burst on a frosty night, and the stairs turned into a waterfall the family slid down at breakfast.
x_water_tank.lore.legendary: Held a whole lake in the loft without the ceiling sagging, and the family now goes upstairs to fish.

coffee_cup.lore.common: Has a lid that dribbles coffee down the chin with every single sip.
coffee_cup.lore.rare: Spells its owner's name wrong in marker pen, and they answer to the wrong name for the rest of the day.
coffee_cup.lore.legendary: Woke a whole office so fast that they finished Friday's work by Monday lunchtime and had nothing to do all week.

coffee_machine.lore.rare: Hisses gossip in its steam: every puff spells out who took the last biscuit.
coffee_machine.lore.legendary: Brewed a coffee so strong that the town clock started ticking twice as fast. Lunch is now at half past nine.

x_ironing_board.lore.rare: Raises itself one notch whenever nobody is looking, until the ironer needs a stepladder.
x_ironing_board.lore.epic: Snapped open at the top of the stairs, and the whole family surfed down to breakfast on it.
x_ironing_board.lore.legendary: Unfolded into a bridge when the river bridge closed, and the whole town crossed to work on its padded cover.

dishwasher.lore.rare: Keeps one teaspoon from every wash somewhere inside itself, and now owns forty.
dishwasher.lore.legendary: Washed a whole bouncy castle in one cycle after a birthday party, and it came out folded and smelling of lemons.

fan.lore.rare: Makes anyone who talks into it sound like a robot for the rest of the day.
fan.lore.epic: Spun so hard that it blew out the birthday candles from across the room before anyone could make a wish.
fan.lore.legendary: Blew the clouds away from sports day so hard that it rained on the teachers' car park instead.

fire_hydrant.lore.rare: Senses a fire three streets away and soaks the barbecue before the sausages are done.
fire_hydrant.lore.epic: Burst its cap on a heatwave afternoon and floated the ice-cream van gently down the high street.
fire_hydrant.lore.legendary: Put out a sunset once because it looked like a fire. The town had to wait until morning for the next one.
fire_hydrant.names.legendary: Hydros, Who Put Out the Sunset

x_champagne_flute.lore.common: Wobbles on its thin stem every time someone says the word 'toast'.
x_champagne_flute.lore.rare: Bubbles so hard that whoever holds it floats a few centimetres off the floor during the toast.
x_champagne_flute.lore.epic: Popped all its bubbles at once in the middle of a wedding speech, and the burp echoed round the hall for a full minute.
x_champagne_flute.lore.legendary: Clinked a note so pure that the chandelier answered, and now they sing a duet at every party.

i_cocktail_shaker.lore.rare: Turns anything poured into it into a milkshake, including the orange juice, the soup and Gran's tea.
i_cocktail_shaker.lore.epic: Was shaken so hard at a party that it turned into a maraca, and the band kept it on stage until midnight.
i_cocktail_shaker.lore.legendary: Mixed a fruit drink so cold that it snowed inside the glass, and the guests drank it wearing mittens.

glass.lore.uncommon: Sticks to its coaster when lifted, then drops it on the table with a clatter.
glass.lore.rare: Fills itself back up to the brim whenever someone says they've had enough.
glass.lore.legendary: Became so perfectly clear that it vanished altogether, and the family has been drinking from thin air ever since.

i_rotisserie.lore.rare: Spins anything near it, so the till, the mop and the price signs all turn slowly round with the chickens.
i_rotisserie.lore.epic: Spun so fast at the summer fair that two chickens flew off the spit and landed in the tombola.
i_rotisserie.lore.legendary: Turned the whole world round once by accident, and the town had two breakfasts that day.

iron.lore.epic: Pressed a crease so sharp into Dad's trousers that he cut the ribbon at the school fair with his knee.
iron.lore.legendary: Ironed out every bump in the village road in one afternoon. The speed bumps have filed a complaint.

x_towel_rack.lore.rare: Swaps everyone's towels in the night, so Dad dries himself on the tiny flannel.
x_towel_rack.lore.epic: Fired every towel off at once when the heating came on, and the dog came to breakfast wrapped like a burrito.
x_towel_rack.lore.legendary: Grew so many rails overnight that it became a ladder to the loft, and the family now climbs it to fetch the suitcases.

mug.lore.rare: Keeps tea hot only for its owner: anyone else who picks it up gets it stone cold.
mug.lore.epic: Was left in the office sink so long that a goldfish moved in, and now it has its own name on the tea rota.

noodles.lore.rare: Ties anyone's shoelaces together from across the table with one long noodle.
noodles.lore.epic: Was slurped so hard that the tablecloth went up with the last noodle, and the plates stayed exactly where they were.
noodles.lore.legendary: Was one noodle so long that it went round the world and came back to the same bowl. It still needed salt.

oven.lore.rare: Turns its own dial up when nobody is looking, so every cake comes out a little more toasted than planned.
oven.lore.epic: Baked a birthday cake that rose so high that it lifted the ceiling, and the upstairs bath ended up in the icing.
oven.lore.legendary: Baked a loaf so big that the village moved into it for the winter. The front door is a crust.

pitcher.lore.rare: Pours whatever drink someone secretly wants instead of the one they asked for, so Gran keeps getting hot chocolate.
pitcher.lore.legendary: Poured lemonade so smoothly that it filled a glass on the far side of the sports field without spilling a drop on the way.

x_soap_dish.lore.epic: Turned the bathroom floor into a skating rink of suds, and the family slid to school in their socks.
x_soap_dish.lore.legendary: Kept its grip on the soap through a storm that blew the whole bathroom away. The soap was still dry.

radiator.lore.rare: Shrinks anything left on it by one size, including the school jumper and Dad's favourite socks.
radiator.lore.epic: Heated the bathroom so much one winter night that the house plants thought it was summer and grew bananas.
radiator.lore.legendary: Kept a house so warm that a polar bear left the Arctic and moved into the airing cupboard.

x_rubber_duckie_bath.lore.common: Fills up with bathwater and squirts it straight into the ear of whoever squeezes it.
x_rubber_duckie_bath.lore.rare: Steers the bath like a boat, so the bather drifts to the tap end whether they like it or not.
x_rubber_duckie_bath.lore.epic: Commanded such a fierce sea battle against the shampoo bottles that the bathroom floor sank under the waves.
x_rubber_duckie_bath.lore.legendary: Let out one squeak so loud that the bathwater jumped out of the tub and landed back in again, still warm.

sink.lore.rare: Swallows rings, earrings and teaspoons down its plughole, then gurgles happily for hours.
sink.lore.legendary: Unblocked itself with one mighty gulp, and every lost teaspoon in town came shooting back up the plughole.

teapot.lore.rare: Spills a little on the table on purpose whenever someone forgets to say please.
teapot.lore.epic: Brewed tea so strong at a garden party that the biscuits stood up on their own and walked out.
teapot.lore.legendary: Brewed a pot so comforting that a thunderstorm stopped overhead to sit down and have a cup.

vending_machine.lore.rare: Ignores the buttons and hands out whatever it thinks people need, which is mostly raisins.
vending_machine.lore.epic: Dropped every snack at once when a fly landed on the button, and the school hallway became a free picnic.
vending_machine.lore.legendary: Stocked itself overnight with snacks nobody has ever invented, and the crisps taste of Wednesday.

waffle_iron.lore.rare: Prints a waffle grid on anything it touches, so the tea towel, the newspaper and the cat's bed come out in neat squares.
waffle_iron.lore.epic: Made a waffle so big that it became the dance floor at the birthday party, and the syrup made everyone stick.
waffle_iron.lore.legendary: Pressed the snowy hill into perfect squares overnight, so the whole town went sledging down a giant waffle.

water_cooler.lore.rare: Burps out the last secret said beside it, in one loud gulp, just as the boss walks past.
water_cooler.lore.epic: Burped a bubble so big that it floated off with the office plant and was last seen over the car park.
water_cooler.lore.legendary: Held so many office secrets that when it burped them all out at once, the whole company swapped jobs.

watering_can.lore.rare: Makes whatever it waters grow a bit too fast, so the lawn needs mowing every hour.
watering_can.lore.epic: Watered the garden gnome by mistake, and it grew so tall that it now waves at passing planes.
watering_can.lore.legendary: Watered a single bean that grew through the clouds, and the giant at the top asked for a refill.

x_air_purifier.lore.rare: Sucks up every smell in the house, including dinner, so nobody knows when the chips are ready.
x_air_purifier.lore.legendary: Cleaned the air over town so well that everyone could see the mountains for the first time. One turned out to be a cloud.

x_bath_tap.lore.uncommon: Squeaks like a mouse whenever it's turned, so the cat waits beside the bath.
x_bath_tap.lore.epic: Was turned so far that it shot the rubber duck through the bathroom window and into next door's pond.

x_beans.lore.uncommon: Always has one bean that escapes the spoon and hides under the toast.
x_beans.lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats it toot a little tune, and it is always the same tune.
x_beans.lore.epic: Slid out of the tin in one perfect cylinder, and the family used it as a door stop for a week.
x_beans.lore.legendary: Fed a hungry giant on a snowy night from one tin, and the giant has been tooting the same tune ever since.

x_beer_stein.lore.epic: Was clinked so hard at the summer fair that it rang like a bell, and the school came out thinking it was home time.
x_beer_stein.lore.legendary: Flipped its lid so hard that the lid flew round the world and landed back on top, slightly sunburnt.

x_bidet.lore.rare: Changes what it is for every time someone asks, and nobody has ever got the same answer twice.
x_bidet.lore.epic: Was turned on full by a curious toddler and launched the soap, the flannel and Dad's sunglasses onto the balcony.

x_bone_china_cup.lore.uncommon: Has a handle so tiny that only one finger fits, and it is never the right finger.
x_bone_china_cup.lore.epic: Was carried across a garden party so carefully that a snail overtook the person carrying it.
x_bone_china_cup.lore.legendary: Made everyone so polite with one sip that a pirate ship moored up for tea and handed back all its treasure.

x_burrito_bowl.lore.rare: Makes every forkful hotter than the last, so the final bite comes with its own fire alarm.
x_burrito_bowl.lore.epic: Was packed so heavy that the delivery bike did a wheelie all the way down the high street.
x_burrito_bowl.lore.legendary: Held a whole birthday party inside it: rice, beans, a band and a bouncy castle made of tortilla.

x_camping_mug.lore.common: Is so dented that it rocks on the table like a boat in a storm.
x_camping_mug.lore.rare: Calls every squirrel in the forest with one clink, and they all want a sip.
x_camping_mug.lore.epic: Was left on the camp stove so long that it glowed, and the whole campsite toasted marshmallows on it.
x_camping_mug.lore.legendary: Fell off a mountain top, bounced off two clouds and landed upright beside the tent, still full of tea.

x_cereal.lore.legendary: Crunched so loudly that it woke the street, the street woke the town, and the town woke the sun an hour early.

x_clothes_dryer_rack.lore.legendary: Held so much washing on a windy day that it took off like a kite and dried the clothes over the whole coast.

x_coleslaw.lore.rare: Shreds anything it is served beside, so the burger arrives in thin strips and the napkin comes as confetti.
x_coleslaw.lore.epic: Slid off a paper plate at the barbecue and landed on Grandad's head like a creamy wig.
x_coleslaw.lore.legendary: Shredded a whole cabbage field in one afternoon, and the farmer had to sell it as the world's biggest side salad.

x_creamer.lore.rare: Curdles the coffee of anyone who is grumpy, so the whole office knows who got out of bed on the wrong side.
x_creamer.lore.epic: Poured so many milk clouds into one cafe's cups that it started to drizzle on the customers.
x_creamer.lore.legendary: Poured a swirl that spun so fast it became a tiny tornado and tidied the whole cafe before closing time.

x_curry.lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats it puff out a little cloud of steam with every word, like a friendly dragon.
x_curry.lore.epic: Was so spicy at curry night that everyone's hair stood on end, and the family photo looks like a row of hedgehogs.
x_curry.lore.legendary: Was cooked so hot that the snow melted off the whole street, and the neighbours came out in shorts in January.

x_dehumidifier.lore.rare: Drinks the water out of anything nearby, so the bath shrinks, the tea goes thick and the houseplants glare at it.
x_dehumidifier.lore.epic: Pulled so much damp out of a rainy afternoon that the clouds outside gave up and went home early.

x_dish_rack.lore.rare: Rearranges the plates overnight from biggest to smallest, so nobody can find their own mug in the morning.
x_dish_rack.lore.legendary: Stacked the plates so high that the tower reached the Moon, and the astronauts finally had somewhere to put their cups.

x_drinking_fountain.lore.rare: Runs ice cold for anyone who pushed in the queue and pleasantly cool for everyone who waited.
x_drinking_fountain.lore.epic: Got stuck on full on sports day and filled the long-jump pit, so the long jump became the long swim.
x_drinking_fountain.lore.legendary: Sprayed a jet so high that it watered the clouds, and the school now gets its own little shower every break time.

x_egg_cup.lore.rare: Draws a little face on any egg put in it, and the faces always look surprised when the top comes off.
x_egg_cup.lore.epic: Was topped so hard that the egg flew off, bounced round the kitchen and landed back in the cup, still runny.
x_egg_cup.lore.legendary: Kept a breakfast egg so warm and safe that it hatched, and the chick now sits in the cup every morning waiting for toast.

x_enamel_mug.lore.common: Chips off one more white speckle every time it is dropped, and it is dropped a lot.
x_enamel_mug.lore.rare: Makes any drink in it taste of woodsmoke, even orange juice at the kitchen table.
x_enamel_mug.lore.epic: Was used to bail out a leaky rowing boat and got the whole family back to shore, with tea leaves in their socks.
x_enamel_mug.lore.legendary: Sat by so many campfires that it learned to boil water on its own, and now it makes tea whenever it hears a tent zip.

x_espresso_cup.lore.rare: Makes anyone who sips it talk twice as fast, so a five-minute phone call is over in two and a half.
x_espresso_cup.lore.epic: Was sipped so fast before a train that its owner overtook the train and had to wait for it at the next station.
x_espresso_cup.lore.legendary: Held one drop of coffee so strong that a sleeping volcano woke up, yawned and asked for another.

x_foot_spa.lore.rare: Tickles the soles of anyone who puts their feet in, and they can't stop giggling until the water goes cold.
x_foot_spa.lore.epic: Bubbled so hard on full power that it shot Grandad's slippers into the ceiling light, where they still hang.
x_foot_spa.lore.legendary: Bubbled the old dog's paws so well that he came out with a puppy's bounce and beat the postman to the door for the first time ever.

x_fried_rice.lore.rare: Flicks grains of rice off the plate whenever a fork comes near, and they end up in everyone's hair.
x_fried_rice.lore.epic: Was tossed so high in the wok that half of it landed on the roof, and the pigeons have been loyal customers ever since.
x_fried_rice.lore.legendary: Was tossed so high that it went into orbit and came back down one grain at a time for a week, like tasty snow.

x_garden_tap.lore.epic: Was turned on so hard that the hose wriggled across the lawn like a snake and chased the cat up a tree.
x_garden_tap.lore.legendary: Pushed water uphill so hard that it filled a lake at the top of the mountain, and the town now goes up there to paddle.

x_granola.lore.rare: Glues honey clusters to everything it touches, so the spoon, the bowl and the dog end up stuck together.
x_granola.lore.epic: Was baked into one cluster so big that the family now uses it as a garden bench.
x_granola.lore.legendary: Fuelled a hiker so well that he walked up a mountain, down the other side and halfway across the sea before noticing.

x_gravy_boat.lore.uncommon: Always ends up in front of the one person at the table who doesn't want any gravy.
x_gravy_boat.lore.rare: Floats on the gravy it has poured and steers itself to whoever likes gravy least.
x_gravy_boat.lore.epic: Poured so much gravy at Sunday lunch that the peas formed a lifeboat crew to rescue the sausages.
x_gravy_boat.lore.legendary: Was launched as a real ship and sailed round the world serving gravy to every lighthouse keeper on the way.

x_humidifier.lore.rare: Turns any word spoken near it into a puff of mist that hangs in the air until someone reads it.
x_humidifier.lore.epic: Was left on all night, and the bedroom woke up as a rainforest with a parrot on the wardrobe.
x_humidifier.lore.legendary: Made a cloud so fluffy that the cat climbed onto it, and it has floated round the house ever since, refusing to come down.

x_juice_glass.lore.common: Saves the bits at the bottom for the very last sip, every single time.
x_juice_glass.lore.epic: Tipped over at breakfast, and the juice spelled out GOOD MORNING across the table before soaking into the toast.
x_juice_glass.lore.legendary: Was held up to the window so often that the sun mistook it for a little sun and now rises in it every morning.

x_lasagna.lore.rare: Swaps the order of its layers when nobody is looking, so the cheese ends up on the bottom and the pasta on top.
x_lasagna.lore.epic: Was carried to a party so heavy that the table sagged in the middle, and the jelly slid down to meet it.
x_lasagna.lore.legendary: Was stacked so high that a lift had to be built to reach the top layer, and the lift attendant gets the crispy corner.

x_loofah.lore.rare: Grows back like the plant it came from if left on a sunny windowsill, and has started climbing the shower curtain.
x_loofah.lore.epic: Scrubbed a mud-covered rugby team so clean that the referee couldn't tell which side was which.
x_loofah.lore.legendary: Scrubbed an old shipwreck so clean that it floated back up and sailed itself into the harbour.

x_mac_and_cheese.lore.rare: Melts any cheese within a metre, so the sandwich beside it and the party cheese board slide onto the floor.
x_mac_and_cheese.lore.epic: Set solid overnight at a sleepover, and the children used the bowl as a bowling ball.
x_mac_and_cheese.lore.legendary: Was baked in a pan so big that the village used it as a swimming pool, and the lifeguard ate the crust.

x_martini_glass.lore.rare: Turns any drink poured into it bright blue, even milk, even soup.
x_martini_glass.lore.epic: Was clinked so hard at a fancy dinner that its olive shot across the room and landed in the guest of honour's soup.
x_martini_glass.lore.legendary: Stood upright on its pointy foot through an earthquake at a fancy dinner, and was the only thing in the room still standing.
x_martini_glass.names.legendary: Stiletta, Who Stood Through the Quake

x_measuring_jug.lore.common: Has lines for millilitres, cups and pints, and every one of them is slightly wrong.
x_measuring_jug.lore.rare: Measures more than liquids: pour in a bad mood and it tells you exactly how many millilitres of grumpy you are.
x_measuring_jug.lore.epic: Was used to bail out a flooded kitchen and counted every drop: 412 litres, two goldfish and a sock.

x_milk_glass.lore.epic: Gave the cat a milk moustache so big that it was mistaken for a tiny grandad at the bus stop.
x_milk_glass.lore.legendary: Built bones so strong in one gulp that its drinker carried the broken-down school bus home on his back.

x_oatmeal.lore.uncommon: Swells up in the bowl, so a small serving always turns into a big one.
x_oatmeal.lore.rare: Sets as hard as cement if it is left alone, and the builders next door now borrow it for walls.
x_oatmeal.lore.epic: Was cooked in a pot so big at scout camp that the whole troop had to stir it with a canoe paddle.
x_oatmeal.lore.legendary: Was so warming that a snowman ate a bowl and came indoors to sit by the fire.

x_paella.lore.rare: Sticks the pan to the stove so firmly that it has to be served where it stands, and the guests eat round the cooker.
x_paella.lore.epic: Was cooked in a pan so wide that it needed its own parking space at the beach party.
x_paella.lore.legendary: Was cooked in a pan so big that a fishing boat sailed into it by mistake, and the crew stayed for lunch.

x_pho.lore.uncommon: Drops its fresh herbs into the broth one by one, until the last spoonful is a salad.
x_pho.lore.rare: Fogs up the glasses of anyone who leans over it, and they stay fogged until the bowl is empty.
x_pho.lore.epic: Was filled so full that the waiter carried it across the restaurant like a tightrope walker, and the whole room held its breath.
x_pho.lore.legendary: Simmered so long that its broth became a hot spring, and the town now goes there to bathe among the noodles.

x_plunger_tool.lore.rare: Sticks itself to whatever it touches, so the fridge, the cat flap and the front door have all been plunged.
x_plunger_tool.lore.epic: Pulled so hard on a blocked drain that the whole street's pipes came up like spaghetti.
x_plunger_tool.lore.legendary: Stuck to the Moon by accident and pulled it a little closer, so the tides are slightly higher on bath night.

x_porridge.lore.rare: Blows a raspberry at anyone who tries to eat it before it has cooled down.
x_porridge.lore.epic: Set so solid at breakfast that the bowl turned over in one piece, and the family used it as a hat stand.
x_porridge.lore.legendary: Was finally just right, not too hot and not too cold, and three bears walked fifty miles to complain about it.

x_ramen_bowl.lore.uncommon: Hides its egg under the noodles whenever a spoon comes near.
x_ramen_bowl.lore.rare: Whistles like a kettle when it's ready, and keeps whistling until somebody says thank you.
x_ramen_bowl.lore.epic: Was made with so many noodles that they hung over the side and down the stairs, and the dog had a midnight feast.
x_ramen_bowl.lore.legendary: Was slurped so loudly that the sound bounced off the Moon and came back as an order for two more bowls.

x_range_hood.lore.rare: Sucks up more than steam: tea towels, recipe cards and once the cook's hat have all gone up the chimney.
x_range_hood.lore.epic: Sucked up the smell of a Sunday roast and blew it over the street, and the neighbours turned up with plates.
x_range_hood.lore.legendary: Sucked a pancake off the pan mid-flip, and it was found next morning on top of the town clock.

x_rice_bowl.lore.common: Rings like a little bell when chopsticks tap it, so everyone knows who wants seconds.
x_rice_bowl.lore.rare: Keeps its rice so warm and fluffy that it gets fluffier every day until it floats off the table.
x_rice_bowl.lore.epic: Was piled so high that the grains rolled off like an avalanche and buried the soy sauce up to its lid.
x_rice_bowl.lore.legendary: Refilled itself for every hungry person in the village, and the rice cooker took early retirement.

x_risotto.lore.rare: Makes the cook's arm keep stirring by itself, hours after dinner, even in bed.
x_risotto.lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole river one spoonful at a time, and the cook still said it needed more stock.

x_sewing_machine_table.lore.rare: Sews anything left near the needle, so the curtains, the tablecloth and the cat's blanket are all joined together.
x_sewing_machine_table.lore.epic: Stitched a whole school play's costumes overnight but sewed every one inside out, so the play was performed backwards.
x_sewing_machine_table.lore.legendary: Stitched a patch on the sky where it was leaking, and it hasn't rained on sports day since.

x_sewing_table.lore.rare: Swaps the buttons on any shirt left on it, so every shirt comes back with odd ones.
x_sewing_table.lore.epic: Measured the house with its tape measure while the family slept, and the kitchen came out two metres longer.
x_sewing_table.lore.legendary: Measured a snake so long that its tape measure ran out of numbers and started using letters.

x_shot_glass.lore.uncommon: Is so small that it gets mistaken for an egg cup, and the egg sits on top looking worried.
x_shot_glass.lore.rare: Shrinks any drink poured into it, so a whole jug of juice fits inside and comes out as one sip.
x_shot_glass.lore.epic: Was turned upside down to catch a spider, and the spider moved in and put up curtains.
x_shot_glass.lore.legendary: Holds a whole thundercloud squeezed into one tiny glass, and it rumbles if anyone puts it down too hard.

x_shower.lore.rare: Rains on whoever is standing next to the shower too, wherever they are in the house.
x_shower.lore.legendary: Rained so warmly one winter morning that a cloud flew in through the window to have a shower.

x_shower_head.lore.rare: Changes the smell of the water every morning, and Tuesdays always smell of onions.
x_shower_head.lore.epic: Was set to full power and peeled the wallpaper off the bathroom, revealing a door nobody knew was there.
x_shower_head.lore.legendary: Sprayed so hard one morning that the water went backwards up the pipes and gave the water tower a shower.

x_soup_mug.lore.rare: Swaps its soup for a different flavour whenever someone stirs it the wrong way round.
x_soup_mug.lore.epic: Steamed so much on a cold bus that the windows fogged, and the driver followed the smell of tomato to the depot.
x_soup_mug.lore.legendary: Chased a whole winter out of town with one steaming mugful, and spring turned up a month early with a runny nose.

x_sponge.lore.rare: Takes on the colour of whatever it wipes, so it has been tomato red, spinach green and, once, tartan.
x_sponge.lore.epic: Swelled up so much in the sink after a dinner party that the kitchen window had to come out to get it outside.
x_sponge.lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole flood in one go and wrung it out over the desert, which now has a lake and a beach.

x_sugar_bowl.lore.rare: Sweetens every drink within arm's reach, so the coffee, the gravy and the soup all taste of sugar.
x_sugar_bowl.lore.legendary: Sweetened a lemon so thoroughly that it packed its bags and went to live with the oranges.

x_tankard.lore.epic: Was banged on the table at the harvest fair so hard that every apple fell off the trees in the orchard next door.
x_tankard.lore.legendary: Spotted a dragon through its glass bottom just in time, and the whole village had the kettle on before it landed.

x_tea_cup_and_saucer.lore.rare: Reads the future in its tea leaves, but only about biscuits.
x_tea_cup_and_saucer.lore.epic: Rattled on its saucer so hard at a tea party that it walked off the table and down the garden path.
x_tea_cup_and_saucer.lore.legendary: Rattled on its saucer in such perfect code that it ordered a cake from the bakery across the road.

x_tea_set.lore.rare: Sets itself out on the table whenever visitors are coming, before anyone knows they are coming.
x_tea_set.lore.epic: Threw a tea party for the garden's teddy bears so grand that the real neighbours queued at the fence to get in.
x_tea_set.lore.legendary: Hosted one tea party for so long that the guests' grandchildren arrived for the final cup, and the cake was still fresh.

x_toilet_brush.lore.common: Leans out from behind the toilet to tickle the ankles of anyone sitting down.
x_toilet_brush.lore.rare: Makes the toilet hum a sea shanty every time it is scrubbed.
x_toilet_brush.lore.legendary: Scrubbed every toilet on a cruise ship in one night, and the captain made it first mate.

x_travel_cup.lore.legendary: Kept its coffee hot for so long that divers found it on the seabed years later, still steaming.

x_water_fountain.lore.rare: Sprays its water into the shape of whatever the nearest child is thinking about, which is mostly ice cream.
x_water_fountain.lore.epic: Had bubble bath tipped into it by a prankster, and the park disappeared under foam up to the top of the swings.
x_water_fountain.lore.legendary: Danced its water so well at the park's birthday that the statue in the middle climbed down to join in.

x_water_pump.lore.rare: Pumps up whatever is underground, so sometimes it's water, sometimes buried treasure and once a very confused worm.
x_water_pump.lore.epic: Was pumped so hard at the village fair that a jet shot over the bunting and soaked the brass band mid-tune.
x_water_pump.lore.legendary: Pumped up an underground river so fast that the village had a new stream by lunchtime and a ferry by teatime.

x_wine_tumbler.lore.uncommon: Wobbles in circles for ages after being put down, like a spinning top.
x_wine_tumbler.lore.rare: Rolls itself across the table to whoever is thirstiest, even if they are on the far side of the room.
x_wine_tumbler.lore.epic: Rolled off a picnic blanket at the top of a hill and knocked over a whole game of skittles at the bottom.
x_wine_tumbler.lore.legendary: Held its juice dead level through a whole rollercoaster ride, and the juice was the only one on the ride that didn't scream.
